Overview

Bauru is a city in SP with a population of 381,706. A major railway and university city in central São Paulo, known for its namesake sandwich, the Bauru, and the Marechal Rondon highway hub. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
